open_points.subject: ResolveAttemptChange
open_points.text: - record_change: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] RecordReadOutcomeChange writes the concluding NodeExecution with its StoredValues and SpooledFiles and no attempt; RecordOperationFailureChange writes one NodeExecution and no attempt; ResolveAttemptChange sets an unknown attempt to the = models.AttemptResolution value; GrantChange writes a StandingGrant with status active; RevokeChange sets an active grant to revoked with revoked_at; RecoverInFlightChange sets one in_flight attempt to unknown with concluded_at, writes its NodeExecution when given and sets used_approval_id's approval to used when given.
open_points.other_text: - EffectAttempt fields (exact, no others exist): run_id: str, node_id: str, map_index: int | None, attempt_number: int, binding_id: str, inputs: tuple[PortRef, ...], idempotency_key: str | None, authority: Authority, status: AttemptStatus, recorded_at: KernelInstant, concluded_at: KernelInstant | None, resolved_by: Actor | None
open_points.question: Must ResolveAttemptChange assign the corresponding AttemptStatus value, or must EffectAttempt.status accept AttemptResolution?

open_points.subject: RecordTrialExecutionChange ordering
open_points.text: - record_change: [DETERMINISM_OR_ORDERING] The records one change writes take their store positions in the order the field-assignment note of its variant lists them, the elements of a list of records in list order (a value list's StoredValues before the record naming them, a RecordRunProgressChange's executions in (node_id, map_index) order); an update keeps the record's position, so positions never depend on record type or database insertion order.
open_points.other_text: - record_change: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] IssueContractVersionChange writes the ContractVersion, plus the Slot with created_slot_purpose as purpose when that is given; AddTrialCaseChange writes the case's StoredValues and the TrialCase; RecordImplementationChange writes the Implementation; RecordTrialExecutionChange writes one TrialExecution and its output StoredValues; RecordAdmissionVerdictChange writes the AdmissionVerdict and, when activate is true, an Activation of the implementation for its contract version at decided_at; RecordActivationChange writes one Activation.
open_points.question: Must RecordTrialExecutionChange assign positions to its StoredValues before the TrialExecution, or follow the listed TrialExecution-then-StoredValues order?

open_points.other_text: - record_change: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] ProposeBindingChange writes an OperationBinding with status proposed; AcceptBindingChange sets a proposed binding to accepted with accepted_at; ComposeFlowVersionChange writes the FlowVersion and its StoredValues, plus the Flow with created_flow_purpose as purpose when that is given; ActivateFlowVersionChange writes one FlowActivation; StartRunChange writes a Run with status running, its pinned implementations, inputs and StoredValues and no waiting points.
open_points.question: Must ComposeFlowVersionChange assign positions to its StoredValues before the FlowVersion, or follow the listed FlowVersion-then-StoredValues order?

open_points.subject: RecordRunProgressChange ordering
open_points.text: - record_change: [DETERMINISM_OR_ORDERING] The records one change writes take their store positions in the order the field-assignment note of its variant lists them, the elements of a list of records in list order (a value list's StoredValues before the record naming them, a RecordRunProgressChange's executions in (node_id, map_index) order); an update keeps the record's position, so positions never depend on record type or database insertion order.
open_points.other_text: - record_change: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] RecordRunProgressChange writes the NodeExecutions from its drafts with their StoredValues and SpooledFiles, then sets the run's status, outputs, waiting points (replacing the previous ones), ended_at and, when the new status is cancelled, cancelled_by; RecordResumptionChange appends one Resumption to the run; ReleaseRunChange sets released_by and released_at of the run.
open_points.question: Must RecordRunProgressChange assign positions to StoredValues before the NodeExecutions that name them, or follow the listed NodeExecutions-then-StoredValues order?

open_points.other_text: - record_change: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] RequestApprovalChange writes an EffectApproval with status requested; DecideApprovalChange sets a requested approval to approved or refused per the = models.OwnerDecision value with decided_at and, for a refusal, writes its refusal_execution as the element's NodeExecution; RecordAttemptInFlightChange writes an EffectAttempt with status in_flight and the inputs the change carries; RecordAttemptOutcomeChange sets the in_flight attempt's status and concluded_at, writes its concluding NodeExecution, StoredValues and SpooledFiles and sets the approval named by used_approval_id to used.
open_points.question: Must RecordAttemptOutcomeChange assign positions to StoredValues before the concluding NodeExecution, or follow the listed NodeExecution-then-StoredValues order?

open_points.subject: remove_run_spool symbolic-link handling
open_points.text: - record_change: [PATH_OR_ARTIFACT_POLICY] Every file and directory under the data directory MUST be opened without following symbolic links; a symbolic link met by any call after start makes that call raise StoreInternalError with nothing written.
open_points.other_text: - remove_run_spool: [BEHAVIOR] MUST remove the spool directory of run_id and everything in it without following symbolic links, and return normally when the spool is already absent or the run is unknown; it never removes anything outside that one run's spool and writes no record.
open_points.question: When remove_run_spool encounters a symbolic link inside the run spool, must it raise StoreInternalError without removing anything, or unlink the symbolic link as part of removing everything?
